images.filename: 2021 Alexandria Union Station from northbound platform.jpg
images.caption: Union Station, located at 110 Callahan Drive in the Old Town neighborhood of Alexandria, Virginia, is served by Amtrak and Virginia Railway Express. The station house was built in 1905 in the Federal Revival style, and was renovated in 1982, with additional improvements made in the mid-1990s.  The Alexandria War Dead Memoria is located outside the station, and the King Street–Old Town station of the Washington Metro lies across the tracks. Union Station was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2013.
images.alt: Union Station, located at 110 Callahan Drive in the Old Town neighborhood of Alexandria, Virginia, is served by Amtrak and Virginia Railway Express. The station house was built in 1905 in the Federal Revival style, and was renovated in 1982, with additional improvements made in the mid-1990s.  The Alexandria War Dead Memoria is located outside the station, and the King Street–Old Town station of the Washington Metro lies across the tracks. Union Station was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2013.

images.filename: The Pentagon US Department of Defense building.jpg
images.caption:
The Pentagon, looking northeast with the Potomac River and Washington Monument in the distance.
The Tidal Basin is seen just below the Washington Monument. The marina which is visible is in Pentagon Lagoon, which is part of the Boundary Channel of the Potomac River. Trees border the Boundary Channel and exist both on the Virginia shoreline and on Columbia Island (an island in the Potomac River).
images.alt:
The Pentagon, looking northeast with the Potomac River and Washington Monument in the distance.
The Tidal Basin is seen just below the Washington Monument. The marina which is visible is in Pentagon Lagoon, which is part of the Boundary Channel of the Potomac River.
